images.prompt: Wide 16:9 premium photorealistic editorial travel illustration of Tagus Cove western Isabela Galapagos Ecuador viewed from a dinghy along the coast. Weathered low brown-grey volcanic tuff cliffs shelter a narrow blue ocean cove, sparse dry pale leafless palo santo scrub high on slope, two small anatomically realistic Galapagos penguins with thin white face stripe and mottled dark chest on low dark shoreline rocks at right, flightless cormorant small beside them. Broad calm deep blue water at left for website title, low natural island shoreline and distant dry volcanic slopes, clear afternoon daylight. No tropical palm trees jungle arctic ice buildings boats crowds writing on rock text watermark logos or collage. Penguins small about 50 cm correct scale, not huge emperor penguins.
